message.content:
This editorial magazine cover, titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters, features a black-and-white photograph of a shirtless man standing with his arms at his sides and hands clenched into fists. He is facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. Several white medical bandages are applied to his chest and abdomen. He wears dark trousers with a visible belt.

To the left of the man, a small rectangular inset image shows two people in uniform and helmets on motorcycles near a dark vehicle on a road. Above this inset, bold black text reads "KESAKSIAN POLISI KORBAN TEROR THAMRIN". Below it, a quote in a serif font reads, “'Dia menembak saya tanpa ekspresi.' — Ajun Inspektur Satu Budiono".

The top of the cover contains the date "1-7 FEBRUARI 2016" and headings "JARINGAN AMAN ABDURRAHMAN" and "KAPAL SAPI JOKOWI". A colorful logo is in the upper-left corner. The bottom-left corner includes a barcode and price "RP 39.500". The entire image is framed by a solid red vertical bar on the left.
